note: The stand-in owner's Decisions. An entry with when_stage is applied only when `kiripix next` is waiting at that Stage; the others are applied together, in order, the first time the Project waits on the owner at a Stage with no entry of its own. `pick: imported` picks the Variant the harness imported. The click lifts the red crate (near 41, 22) into the Layer `crate`; it lands in needs-review, and the owner accepts a Stage in needs-review (layers, then masks, as `next` reports them). The ysort line sorts that Layer. The entries with an `asset` are for the character: its three clips (idle, walk, attack), made from the actions the pre-rigged fixture Model holds, answered when `next` waits at clips. Its Model needs no Mixamo round trip.
